title: Dashboard New Todo Submit Permission Consistency

items.action: create a todo from the dashboard modal

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing todo create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing todo create authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

tenant_isolation.reason: Existing organization-scoped todo authorization remains unchanged.

audit.reason: Existing todo creation audit behavior remains unchanged.

route_guard.reason: This change hardens the dashboard modal action callback, not route access.

notes: The dashboard quick action already requires fair_crm.todos.create. The modal submit callback now independently fails closed on the same permission, and the save affordance is hidden without it. TodoForm continues to gate optional checklist editing/submission with fair_crm.todos.update.
